full_judgment:
33. On perusal of the evidence on record, if appears that the examination of the testimonies of the witnesses would show that the learned Additional Sessions Judge based his judgment merely on his presumption rather than on fact Of on evidence. The main fact which the learned Additional Sessions Judge had taken into consideration for finding the accused guilty was the calling and taking away of the victim by the accused Bablu from the house, None but father of the deceased Kalimuddin, who is PW 1, deposed about the calling and taking away of deceased Abdul Latif by the accused Bablu alias Babu. Such solitary evidence of PW 1 without any corroboration cannot be relied upon. As regard circumstantial evidence, principle have been set out in the case of State vs Arman Ali reported in 42 DLR (AD) 50 wherein it is held that in a case based on circumstantial evidence, before any hypothesis of guilt can be drawn on the basis of circumstances themselves, have to be proved like any other fact beyond reasonable doubt. Unless the Court is careful there will always be a chance to come to a wrong conclusion resulting in wrong conviction. The Court should always be watchful to see that suspicion and conjecture do not take the place of proof. Unfortunately, that is what has happened in the present case. The learned Additional Sessions Judge totally failed to apply his judicial mind to appreciate the evidence on record in its true perspective. Because there is no eye-witness of murder. The testimony of the prosecution witnesses does not attribute any overt act on the part .of the accused. Therefore, the prosecution has failed to establish beyond doubt the direct or indirect involvement of the accused in the offence charged against him. It is well settled law that last seen together is a weak type of circumstantial evidence on which to have a conviction, a link between the accused and the murder has to be proved. 

 37. the main principle of criminal law is that an accused person must be presumed to be innocent unless arid until it is established by the prosecution beyond reasonable doubt that the accused person is guilty; As regard the burden of proof, it is written in Wharton's Law Lexicon (Fourteenth Edition) that the point in issue is to be proved by the party who asserts the affirmative and the burden of proof lies on the person who has to support his case by proof of a fact which is peculiarly within his own knowledge, of which he is supposed to be cognisant. It is also written in Black's Law Dictionary that the burden denotes the duty of establishing by a fair preponderance of the evidence the truth of the operative facts upon which the issue at hand is made to turn to be substantive law. 

 38. The established principle of law as regard the burden of proof lies on the party who substantially asserts the affirmative of the issue and not upon the party who denies. The party on whom the onus of proof lies must, in order to succeed, prove the reliable evidence. He cannot on failure to do so, take advantage of the weakness of defence case. He must succeed by the strength of his own evidence and the clearness of his own proof. 

 39. In a criminal trial, the burden of proving the guilt of the accused beyond all reasonable doubts always rests on the prosecution and on its failure it cannot fall back upon the evidence adduced by the accused in support of his defence to rest its case solely thereon. In criminal cases it is for the prosecution to bring the guilt home to the accused. The fundamental and basic presumption in the administration of criminal law and justice delivery system is the innocence of the alleged accused till the charges are proved beyond reasonable, doubt on the basis of clear, cogent, credible or unimpeachable evidence. 

 40. In the instant case, the learned trial Court by his judgment and order shifted the onus of proof upon the shoulders of the accused which is contrary to above principle and in arriving at the finding, the learned Judge has grossly missed the legal position. 

 44. It must be re-called that we established rule of criminal justice is that "Fouler the crime higher the proof." In the instant case the life mid liberty of the subject was at stake. Accused Bablu alias Babu was given a sentence of life imprisonment, a careful, cautious and meticulous approach ought to have been made by the State in the interest of justice. But the learned Additional Sessions Judge has totally failed to do so.
